decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink mix is peripheral to the industrial waste-to-energy focus and was not visible in 2020–2021, so withdrawal is a real risk, but it is cheap to maintain and draws on the established nutrient offer.
The modular plant extensions complement the core waste-to-energy plants and the multi-model line, so they are likely to stay despite limited recent visibility.
The waste oil to energy plant is a flagship in the firm's core direction, and its strategic fit outweighs the risk suggested by the withdrawal of the sibling plastic-to-fuel plant.
